kaleidoscopecookery_automation.ponder.st: Automating the Stock Pot with a Mechanical Arm
First, set the target recipe for the Stockpot.
If no SoupBase has been added, the Mechanical Arm will attempt to add the SoupBase item to the pot, returning the container.
Next, the Mechanical Arm will insert the matching ingredients into the pot.
Once the ingredients in the pot perfectly match the recipe, the Mechanical Arm will place the lid on the Stockpot.
Now, just wait for a while...
When cooking is complete, a Mechanical Arm set to output from the Stockpot will remove the lid.
Finally, the Mechanical Arm will scoop the finished dish from the Stockpot using a container. (The number of serving containers must be 1 or match the remaining portions in the pot.)
kaleidoscopecookery_automation.ponder.po: Automating the Pot with a Mechanical Arm
First, set the target recipe for the Pot.
If there is no oil in the pot, the Mechanical Arm will add oil to it. (Oil | Oil Pot | Kitchen Shovel With Oil)
Next, the Mechanical Arm will insert the matching ingredients into the pot.
Once the ingredients in the pot perfectly match the recipe, the Mechanical Arm will begin stirring-frying.
Now, just wait for a while...
When cooking is complete, the Mechanical Arm will scoop the finished dish from the Pot using a container. (The number of serving containers must match the recipe's output count.)
kaleidoscopecookery_automation.ponder.st: Automating the Steamer with a Mechanical Arm
If there is an empty slot in the Steamer, the Mechanical Arm will insert ingredients that have a Steamer recipe.
Now, just wait for a while...
When cooking is complete, a Mechanical Arm set to input from the Steamer will extract the product.
kaleidoscopecookery_automation.ponder.sh: Automating the Shawarma Spit with a Mechanical Arm
If the Shawarma Spit is empty, the Mechanical Arm will insert materials that have a campfire recipe onto the spit.
Now, just wait for a while...
When cooking is complete, a Mechanical Arm set to input from the Shawarma Spit will extract the product.
